disputes.a: The guides say 18 meditation spots for the trophy.

disputes.title: #28 — does the Chapter 1 balcony meditation count?

disputes.b: The lists treat the eight as a fixed, known set.

disputes.title: #25 — is the full set of strangers even known?

disputes.a: Believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

disputes.title: #49 Bad Luck, I Guess — what triggers it?

disputes.b: Push Square: 250+ hours.
